maṇi: [Maṇa+i] (thī,pu) CL=7 [If relates Īpaccaya Ṇī. Mana+i. Mā+ṇi. Mana+i+kvi. Maṇati jotati pabhāsatīti maṇi. Atha vā janānaṃ manaṃ pūrento somanassaṃ karonto ito gato pavattoti "maṇi". Apa,ṭṭha,2.156. Cittaṃ ārādheti somanassaṃ karotīti "maṇi". Atha vā māti pamāṇaṃ karoti ābharaṇanti maṇi. Atha vā marantāpi rājayuvarājādayo taṃ na pariccajanti tadatthāya saṅgāmaṃ karontīti "maṇi". Apa,ṭṭha,2.183. Sūci. Manati mahagghabhāvaṃ gacchaṃtīti maṇi=ratanaṃ. Moga, 7. 8.] (1) Treasure gem. (In Udāna.141, as well "maṇi"puda translates  udāna,ṭṭha.274-ka maṇīti rattanīlādikedo anekavidho maṇi, in Kaṅkhā. 169, as well "maṇi"pada translates Kaṅkhā,ṭī,saca.31va-ka maṇitiṭhapetvā veḷuriyādike antamaso jātiphalikaṃ upādāya sabbopi nīlapītādivaṇṇabhedo maṇīti veditabbo. According to the upper status Maṇisaddā- is treasure gem. Althought Pattamrāḥ, mra are without meaning, (A) (B) As well a state of  making copies, translates that are the gem on the crested headdress, the ruby ring (ornament of finger) as a simile. From Dhāna.490- explains seven kinds of gems, Maṇi"pada is ruby by Pārisesa way and Gobalibaddha way). (A) Ruby. A ruby stone.  (B) Emerald. (C) Paste jewel (articicial gem). (D) Gems of a crested headdress.  (C) gem for ring. (2) Gem. (3) A big pot. (dhāna. Syha). A big glazed earthen pot. (dhāna, syha. Saca). (4) Dice made of gem. (5) Ink. (6) A bright gem. (E) Gem of a ring (an ornament of a finger). See - Maṇimuddik. (6) A bright ball gem. See - Maṇikāra-(C). See original.

maṇḍa:
[Maṇḍa+a]  CL=9 [References: Than, Ti. 67. Man+Da. Mog, 7.58. Madi+ka. Ru, Hna. 15. Kaccana. 663.]
(1) Clarity, purification.
(2) Ornament, decoration, adorning.
(3) Sunlight.
(4) First extract (rice water, fermented liquor, etc.).
(5) Clear liquid.
(adj.)
(6) (a) That which is clear, pure. (The exact center of the earth is called "manda" because it is the point of clarity for the knowledge of Arahantship and Omniscience. Therefore, the word "manda" can also be translated as center, pillar, or core.)
(b) One who is clear, pure.
maṇḍabhūmi: [Maṇḍa+bhūmi] (thī) CL=7 The best land. The land that has a lot of nourishment. Swamp land.
maṇḍabya: [Maṇḍapa+ṇya] (pu) CL=7 [Pa change to ba. Maṇḍapa+bya. cancel Pa]. One who was born in a pavilion and named Maṇḍabya.

maṇḍala:
[Maṇḍa+ala]  CL=9 'Maṇḍayate ti maṇḍalaṃ. Alo, itthiyaṃ maṇḍalī. Ayaṃ tīsvapi. Dhān, Ṭī. 53-4. Avayavena maṇḍatīti maṇḍalaṃ. Maṇḍa vibhūsāyaṃ. Alo. Dhān, Ṭī. 631. Maḍi+ala. Maḍi bhūsāyaṃ, alo. Dhān, Ṭī. 296.]
(1) Circle, orb. (Includes moon disc, sun disc, zodiac circle, wheel, etc. In astrology, it"s said to have three genders according to Dhān, Ṭī.)
(2) Section, compartment. (In Pali, "maṇḍala" is used for large and small sections of the five-sectioned monastic robe. In Vinaya commentaries, mahāmaṇḍala refers to a large house compound or main house, and aḍḍhamaṇḍala to a subdivision or small house. See the note on "kusi" in Tipiṭaka Dhān, Volume 6. The term is also used for patterns on a snake"s back.)
(3) Group, collection. (Dhān. 693 - In explaining the term maṇḍala, it"s shown to mean a group of villages, the orb of celestial bodies, the circle of sunlight, a group, or a collection.)
(4) Assembly (according to some interpretations).
(5) Bowl, hollow vessel.
(adj.) (6) Circular, round.
(5) See tulapañjara.
(6) See maṇḍalagga.
